scripts.preinstall: node -e "const p=require('./package.json');const pkgs=['prisma','@prisma/config','@prisma/client','@prisma/adapter-mssql'];for(const k of pkgs){const v=p.dependencies?.[k]||p.devDependencies?.[k];if(v){const major=parseInt(v.replace(/^[^0-9]*/,''),10);if(major<7){console.error('ERROR: '+k+' is '+v+' in package.json — must be 7.x. Aborting install.');process.exit(1);}}}"
